description: Electrisim, published by Electrisim, provides browser-based electrical-network studies using pandapower, OpenDSS and ANDES. The linked provider page supplies documentation and the access route; no resource files were downloaded. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (Electrisim; per-seat commercial-use licence on paid plans). Price and access terms require confirmation unless explicitly stated above. Limitations: The browser editor and paid cloud simulation service have different access conditions. Provider validation claims were not independently reproduced. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: model-pandapower is one of the underlying engines; the browser application also advertises OpenDSS and ANDES.
